Korea Investment Corp Increased Royal Bk Cda Montreal Que (RY) Holding
July 12, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Korea Investment Corp increased its stake in Royal Bk Cda Montreal Que (RY) by 6.05% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Korea Investment Corp bought 71,499 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.00% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.25M shares of the commercial banks company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $96.71M, up from 1.18 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Korea Investment Corp who had been investing in Royal Bk Cda Montreal Que for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $112.44B market cap company. The stock increased 1.26% or $0.96 during the last trading session, reaching $77.13. About 526,060 shares traded. Royal Bank of Canada (NYSE:RY) has risen 9.18% since July 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.39% the S&P500.
Korea Investment Corp, which manages about $21.49 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Sherwin Williams Co (NYSE:SHW) by 9,893 shares to 97,188 shares, valued at $38.11M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Melco Crown Entmt Ltd (NASDAQ:MPEL) by 272,100 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 207,800 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
